about: Drumheller is a town in the Red Deer River badlands of southern Alberta, northeast of Calgary. Hoodoos, the Royal Tyrrell Museum of Palaeontology, and a compact valley downtown define Canada’s best-known dinosaur-country community. About 8,000 people live in Drumheller.
seoSummary: Red Deer River badlands town—Royal Tyrrell Museum, hoodoos, and dinosaur-country downtown northeast of Calgary.
